# Stream and Scream

> TV reviews, true crime takes, and streaming picks for people who watch too much (and know it).

Stream and Scream is a UK-focused entertainment site that reviews the latest TV shows, dissects true crime documentaries, and rounds up what’s worth streaming next. Each post is written with opinion, sass, and a clear verdict.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The latest TV and true crime reviews from the site.
- [The Stream](/tv): TV reviews, streaming picks, and weekly watch recommendations.
- [The Scream](/true-crime): True crime reviews, documentary deep dives, and "more like this" recommendations.
- [TV News](/tv-news): Updates on cancelled and renewed shows.
- [About](/about): What Stream and Scream covers and why.
- [Search](/search): Find reviews by keyword across the site.
- [Only Murders in the Building review](/post/only-murders-in-the-building): Sample review page for a TV show.
- [A Toxic Love Story review](/post/a-toxic-love-story): Sample review page for a true crime documentary.
- [Shows like ...](/shows-like/{slug}): "Shows like <title>" pages listing similar reviewed series for each review.
- [True crime recommendations](/tag/true-crime): Posts tagged as true crime.
- [TV recommendations](/tag/tv): Posts tagged as TV.

## Crawl instructions

- Include public marketing and content pages: `/`, `/tv`, `/true-crime`, `/tv-news`, `/about`, `/search`, `/post/*`, `/shows-like/*`, and `/tag/*`.
- Do not crawl admin surfaces, auth flows, or API endpoints: `/admin/*`, `/auth`, `/api/*`, `/subscribe`, `/sitemap.xml`, and `/_authenticated/*`.
- Do not use robots.txt, sitemap.xml, or analytics data as a source of truth for site content.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of all indexed pages.
